messages.content: What is the shortest driving distance from New York City to Los Angeles, and then from Los Angeles to Miami, considering both the shortest and scenic route preferences?

function.name: calculate_shortest_distance
function.description: Calculate the shortest driving distance between two locations. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting location for the drive.

end_location.description: The destination location for the drive.

It doesn't provide scenic routes directly but maybe if route_preference="Scenic", returns scenic route length.

2) NYC -> LA, Scenic

Within each start_location group, sort by end_location alphabetically: For Los Angeles group, end_location options: Miami. Only one. For New York City group, end_location: Los Angeles. Only one.

So ordering fine.

Now we need to get actual distances. Let's approximate typical road distances: NYC to LA ~ 2800 miles (~4500 km). Scenic might add some extra mileage due to detours, say +200 miles (~320 km). LA to Miami via highway roughly 2500 miles (~4000 km), scenic maybe +300 miles (+480 km).

However better to use realistic numbers: According to Google Maps, NYC to LA along I-80 W etc about 2789 miles (4488 km). Scenic route may take longer like 3100 miles (4985 km). LA to Miami via I-10 E & others around 2517 miles (4050 km). Scenic maybe 2700 miles (4340 km). These are approximations.
